title: Satin Chrome Towel Bar, 30-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Satin Chrome, towel bar, 30-inch wall mount straight bar made from solid brass for bathroom towel storage and drying, which provides a brushed, matte-like surface that resists fingerprints while maintaining a modern, understated elegance. Center-to-center 30 in with 0.75 in bar diameter; traditional style hardware for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures. Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look; includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware. Wall-mounted design saves space and installs easily. Weight capacity 10 lb.  and backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty. Matching Carolina collection coordination. Allied Brass Carolina.
